 Investment in sports reaches far beyond teams and players, connecting finance, technology, real estate and media. Sportico Invest New York returns to Nasdaq on Nov. 10, bringing together leaders shaping that expanding landscape for a day of conversations about the business behind the games.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Grant Hill, Steve Greenberg and Al Tylis are the latest additions to the Invest New York speaker lineup, joining José E. Feliciano and bringing distinct perspectives on ownership, dealmaking and the flow of capital into sports.

 The Naismith Basketball Hall of Famer, Hill, brings experience spanning the court and the boardroom, with ownership interests across the NBA, MLB, MLS and NWSL. His investment portfolio offers a window into athletes' growing influence as owners and business builders.
 Greenberg, an Allen & Company managing director, has helped shape sports through decades of work on franchise transactions and media strategy. Tylis, CEO of Apollo Sports Capital, adds a perspective on institutional investment as increasingly sophisticated financing reshapes the industry.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Together, the additions bring fresh depth to a program examining who is investing in sports, where capital is moving and what comes next.
 Now in its fifth year, Sportico 's Invest New York has established itself as the definitive gathering for the money behind the games—examining the who, what and why behind an industry experiencing a global explosion. Invest New York cuts through the clutter and jargon for a clear and concise examination of what's happening across the sports investing landscape. This year's event is presented by Inner Circle Sports, a William Blair Business. Other sponsors include Nasdaq, Omega Sports and Davis Polk. Register here .
